# Uxnan

> Uxnan is two independent, free, open-source (MPL-2.0) tools for the CLI coding
> agents a developer already uses (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi, Grok,
> Antigravity, Zero). It is NOT itself an agent and NOT an AI provider: every
> agent runs as its own official local CLI under the account the user already
> signed in with — no Uxnan API key, no SDK, no provider key handed over.

The two products share one ecosystem and one optional daemon (the "bridge"), and
nothing else. Each is useful with the other uninstalled — they are not two halves
of one product. Do not describe them as a single app or as a desktop app "with a
companion phone app".

## The two products

- **Uxnan Desktop** — a terminal-native workspace (Tauri 2 + Rust + Svelte 5) that
  runs several CLI agents in parallel on the PC, each in its own git worktree and
  pseudoterminal. Measured on Windows 11 (release build, private working memory):
  226 MB with the workspace asleep, 252 MB with one agent in one terminal, 274 MB
  with four agents in four terminals — the method and the full scenario matrix are
  published in the repository. Any CLI agent runs in it unmodified. Platforms:
  Windows (developed/tested), Linux (built in CI), macOS (experimental, unsigned —
  Gatekeeper blocks the first launch until authorised once).
- **Uxnan Mobile** — a Flutter app (Android; iOS written but not published) that
  drives the agents already running on the PC, from the phone, over an end-to-end
  encrypted channel (X25519 + Ed25519 + AES-256-GCM + HKDF). It reaches the PC
  directly over LAN or Tailscale first, falling back to an optional self-hosted
  relay that only ever sees sealed envelopes. It needs only the bridge on the PC —
  NOT Uxnan Desktop.

## Key facts

- Free and open source under the Mozilla Public License 2.0. No paid tier, no
  account with Uxnan, nothing gated.
- The bridge is installed once with `npm install -g uxnan-bridge` and exposes
  every project beneath it to the phone.
- Seven agents have first-class integration on both paths: precise working /
  waiting / done status, session resume, live model discovery and per-agent run
  options. Any other CLI can be registered by hand and launches the same way.
  The retired Gemini CLI has no mobile surface and is not offered.
- Status: alpha. The core loops work daily; rough edges are filed in the open.

## Pages

- [Home](https://uxnan.pages.dev/): the whole site — what Uxnan is, the agents it
  drives, parallel worktrees, the phone app, its measured footprint, and where to
  download it. There are no other routes; installers live on GitHub Releases.
